free_tier_limits.correction: Up to 100 devices and 100,000 Data Operations per month; the plan documentation also specifies up to 100 MB of pooled cellular data per month.

rate_limits.correction: Published limits include 10,000 requests per 5 minutes per source IP for all API functions, plus stricter route-specific limits and a maximum of 100 simultaneous event-stream connections.

notes: The API remains operational, but the entry hides published pricing and request limits. Its example uses deprecated query-string authentication, which is unavailable to accounts created after December 4, 2024. Particle identifies authentication as OAuth2 access-token authentication, not an API key scheme.
